summary: Sequence sheets for XA-5 oral suspension in-use stability under WA/2022/226 for Xarnelvune Pharmaceuticals: ICH chamber pulls to eighteen months on the reconstituted and unopened product. Assay and related substances remain within specification; the resuspension check after storage supported the dosing instructions, and Xarnelvune added a shake-before-use line to the label.

sheets.name: Stability

rows.v: ICH chamber programme: pulls and results

rows: Assay as % label claim, impurities as % area. Water by Karl Fischer, % w/w. Bottles were stored upright and shaken before each withdrawal, as per the protocol.

rows.v: Resuspension after storage: dosing instruction basis

rows: Bottles held at the labelled storage condition were left unshaken for the stated interval, then resuspended by hand before sampling. Observations recorded per bottle.
Uniform after the labelled number of inversions
Samples taken from top, middle and bottom of the bottle
Shake-before-use instruction added to the label
